sales_hooks: Huawei Ascend 910C is creating a self-contained China AI supply chain — NVIDIA export controls are accelerating China's domestic HBM alternatives (CXMT), which threatens global HBM supplier market share in China.

Huawei CloudMatrix 384 cluster benchmarks are improving rapidly — if China AI self-sufficiency succeeds, ~35% of global AI compute demand could be served domestically, reducing HBM export addressable market.
China hyperscalers (ByteDance, Baidu, Alibaba) are dual-sourcing: NVIDIA (where licenses allow) + Huawei Ascend — understanding this split is critical for memory supplier sales into China.
Huawei's domestic memory reliance on CXMT creates a vulnerability: CXMT's HBM-equivalent is 1-2 generations behind SK Hynix/Samsung — this gap is a sales opportunity if export controls relax.
